meta.name: ai-wrapper-product
meta.description: Expert in building products that wrap AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) into focused tools people will pay for. Not just "ChatGPT but different" - products that solve specific problems with AI. Covers prompt engineering for products, cost management, rate limiting, and building defensible AI businesses. Use when "AI wrapper, GPT product, AI tool, wrap AI, AI SaaS, Claude API product, " mentioned.
